The Label fields sit in the middle of each model card, with a lot of empty space before the provider and model ID on the right, so the row looks unbalanced.
The 'Test connection' button wraps below the Jev key input instead of lining up with 'Save key'.
The Jev key input is empty even though the status reads 'Saved · ••••1d17', which could confuse users. Showing the masked key or a placeholder would help.
The second model card's description is cut off at the bottom of the scroll area, but the page scrolls, so it is still reachable.
'Supported efforts: low, high' is in small, low-contrast grey text, though it is still readable.
